notes: Cut ends: every open cut runs half a kerf past its wire end, arc lit, no coast - including cuts that finish on an arc. New Cut end overrun (extra) setting. Angle rips and copes that end on a wire keep the overrun. Holes take the same rule (toggle in Settings > Holes): the arc stays lit half a kerf past closure instead of a flat 1 mm - the flat spot on the back face at the lead-in. Nests: one cut per common seam, per-part cutting windows drawn on the beam, split long cuts keep their kerf offset, lead-in on every long rip (toggle), rips cut toward the stock, and on right-to-left cells a turned bar keeps its parts at the lead end. Tees: offsets reach the face they trim (stem PR[84]/[85], flange PR[86]/[87]) with Lateral / Height on the real tilted planes, new Air moves clearances, and the MEBP stem find no longer drops the torch toward the stem. Angles: an other-leg cope keeps its along-the-bar cut when loaded directly. Imperial readout in both apps (feet-inches, inches, or inches below 5') with fractions in every length box. ORBIT / PAN / ZOOM touch buttons. Camera feeds no longer resize and jump.
